ITEM 1 | Shredded orange strands, thin and matchstick-like (about 0.2-0.3 cm wide, 5-8 cm long), bright orange with slight darker orange variation, matte with slight moisture, forming a loose tangled mound in the center-left of the bowl | 60
ITEM 2 | Thin white onion rings/half-rings, pale translucent white with slight sheen, about 0.3 cm thick, lying on top of the shredded strands in the center | 8
ITEM 3 | Green pepper pieces, bright green flat strips about 0.5 cm wide and 3-4 cm long, glossy skin, scattered around the left and lower edge of the mound | 25
ITEM 4 | Red pepper pieces, deep red glossy strips about 0.5-1 cm wide and 3-4 cm long, slightly curled edges, scattered under and around the carrot mound, upper right and lower center | 25
